options.text: Keeping control while guiding a newer partner through the position

options.feedback: Never. Every finish is released instantly on the tap, every time. The tap is law.

options.text: Hurting your partner because you can
options.feedback: That is the one thing the Back Pin exists to teach you not to do. Total control with the choice not to harm is the core of the whole program.
